## Notes to the parent Company financial statements continued

## 10. Creditors: amounts falling due within one year

|                                       |   Notes |   2019 £ million | 2018 £ million   |

| Trade creditors                       |         |              2.3 | 1.4              |
| Owed to subsidiaries                  |         |             90.4 | 84.8             |
| Accruals                              |         |              5.1 | 4.5              |
| Deferred income                       |         |              3.2 | 4.4              |
| Lease liabilities                     |      14 |              0.1 | -                |
| Other taxes and social security costs |         |              0.4 | 0.5              |
| Government grants                     |      12 |              0.7 | 0.3              |
|                                       |         |            102.2 | 95.9             |

Trade creditors are non-interest bearing and are normally settled on 30 to 60-day terms. Other creditors are non-interest bearing.

The Directors consider that the carrying amount of trade creditors approximates their fair value.
